provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: Two of the dogs in the home are overdue for the rabies vaccines.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The child proof latch on the cabinet under the kitchen sink needs to be replaced as it is broken and children have access to cleaning supplies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: The assistant caregiver lacked documentation of 24 hours training to complete last years annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: One child's record evaluated lacked signed documentation by the parent that the parent received a copy of the parents rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One employees record lacked a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment with a Licensed Operation or Registered Child-Care Home (Form 2985).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §747.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: An assistant caregiver did not have CPR/First aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child's food allergy plan was not signed by the health care professional nor signed by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §747.3619)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Self- Instructional 80%: The director lacked 6 hours of instructor-led training to complete last years annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Self- Instructional up to 80% (26 TAC §747.1309(i))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: One child's Epi pen was not in its original container or labeled with the child s full name and the date brought to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §747.3605(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The changing mat was observed torn with exposed foam.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §747.3303(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: The operation did not have written infant feeding instructions on file for the 9 month old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked information whether or not the parent gives permission for transportation (such as for emergency care), one child's immunization record was observed incomplete, and one child's record lacked a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience: The director lacked documentation of completion of training in the following topics to complete last years annual training: 1) Emergency Preparedness; 2) Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; 3) Understanding building and physical premises safety; and 4) Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: The director lacked documentation of completion of one hour of training in the following topic to complete last years annual training: (1) Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome; (2)  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and  (3)  Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual was present at inspection without a background check. This was corrected at inspection as the individuals background check was submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were evaluated and lacked written procedures for the following: 1) Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity and 2) How parents may access the HHSC website (www.hhs.texas.gov).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked the address of the responsible individual (friend or relative) who should be contacted in an emergency when the parent cannot be reached.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Permitted Before April 25, 2021 & No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing by May 25, 2021: The operation did not have documentation on file showing they have notified parents of two children enrolled that the operation does not carry liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Permitted Before April 25, 2021 & No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing by May 25, 2021 (26 TAC §747.213(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The operation did not have documentation that the operation tested the smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detector for the month of April 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)
